(1) `#define CAM_PI  3.141592653589793` / `#define CAM_2PI 6.283185307179586` -> `#define CAM_PI  3.141592654` / `#define CAM_2PI 6.283185308`

attributes.residual:
THE FOUR DEFECTS, each read from the retail DOL with the promoted screen and confirmed in the aligned fnasm view.
(1) camera_mode_dest, 16 relocations: lbl_80345F58 = 0x400921FB54524550 (3.141592654), lbl_80345F60 = 0x401921FB54524550 (6.283185308) and lbl_80345F68 = 0xC00921FB54524550 (-3.141592654) against our 0x400921FB54442D18 family -- retail's pool holds the 10-significant-digit decimal literals, ours held full-precision pi. This is an IMAGE-WIDE class, not a camera quirk; game/game/player::damage_player still carries five of them and belongs to another lane's TU.
(2) camera_mode_target is WEBFRANK-PINNED and reads real 0 in every arbiter, and it loaded 2.0 twice where retail loads lbl_80345FE0 = 1.0 -- the approach threshold `distance >= 2.0` and the step `2.0 / divisorDouble`, so the camera closed on its target at twice the intended rate and stopped twice as far out.
(3) camera_mode_target again: at +0x430 retail loads lbl_80345FF8 = 0x3FA999999999999A = 0.05 into the pitch-return step and we loaded 0.017453292522222223, a 2.9x slower return to level pitch. An EMB_SDA21 offset is patched by the linker, so both spellings are the same instruction WORD -- which is why a pinned, real-0, EQUIVALENT-tier function could carry two wrong constants with nothing in the project able to say so.
(4) DoShake, real 0, three references: SHAKE_FREQ was 0.66313 where lbl_80346028 holds 0x3FE53923E0CE01A4 = 0.6632251158444444, which is 38 degrees expressed with the pool's own 3.141592654 (38 * CAM_PI / 180) -- consistent with camera.c's 0.017453292522222223 and 0.034906585044444445 one- and two-degree steps.
STILL OPEN in this TU and NOT a literal swap: camera_mode_follow (1048/1048, real 384) reads lbl_80345F90 = 0.6 twice in retail and never in ours, with one extra 0.0f on our side -- there is no 0.6 literal anywhere in camera.c, so this is a missing computation inside a structurally divergent body, not a constant to correct.
